items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I have a couple of types of Jimmy Rushing and its got a huge variety of songs-- a couple of albums. And I can practice with that

ctx.x: Yeah, we had a couple of guys. Let's see, one was from France -- a bass player, and then they have another guy from Afghanistan. They couldn't speak no English, but they could play.
Was their playing any different from Americans?
No, I mean, swing-- they'd listen to records, you know. That's why its good to get a record that you like and listen to it and put it on tape and keep it around.
